Q1a.en: A function \(f : X \rightarrow Y\) is onto when every element of the codomain \(Y\) is the image of some element of \(X\), that is, when its range equals its codomain. So the range must be \(Y\), which is the choice \(Y\).
Q1a.hi: फलन \(f : X \rightarrow Y\) आच्छादक तब होता है जब सहप्रान्त \(Y\) का प्रत्येक अवयव \(X\) के किसी अवयव का प्रतिबिम्ब हो, अर्थात् जब उसका परिसर उसके सहप्रान्त के बराबर हो। अतः परिसर \(Y\) होना चाहिए, जो विकल्प \(Y\) है।

Q1b.en: For \(|x| \ge 1\), \(\sec^{-1} x + \operatorname{cosec}^{-1} x = \frac{\pi}{2}\). So the value is \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\), which is the choice 0.
Q1b.hi: \(|x| \ge 1\) के लिए \(\sec^{-1} x + \operatorname{cosec}^{-1} x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) होता है। अतः मान \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\) है, जो विकल्प 0 है।

Q1c.en: Two vectors are perpendicular when their scalar product is zero: \((2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \lambda\hat{k}) \cdot (\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} + \hat{k}) = 2 + 4 - \lambda = 0\). So \(\lambda = 6\), which is the choice 6.
Q1c.hi: दो सदिश लम्बवत् होते हैं जब उनका अदिश गुणनफल शून्य हो: \((2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \lambda\hat{k}) \cdot (\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} + \hat{k}) = 2 + 4 - \lambda = 0\)। अतः \(\lambda = 6\), जो विकल्प 6 है।

Q1d.en: Split the integrand: \(\frac{\sin^2 x - \cos^2 x}{\sin^2 x \cos^2 x} = \frac{1}{\cos^2 x} - \frac{1}{\sin^2 x} = \sec^2 x - \operatorname{cosec}^2 x\). Since \(\int \sec^2 x\,dx = \tan x\) and \(\int \operatorname{cosec}^2 x\,dx = -\cot x\), the integral is \(\tan x + \cot x + C\), which is the choice \(\tan x + \cot x + C\).
Q1d.hi: समाकल्य को तोड़िए: \(\frac{\sin^2 x - \cos^2 x}{\sin^2 x \cos^2 x} = \frac{1}{\cos^2 x} - \frac{1}{\sin^2 x} = \sec^2 x - \operatorname{cosec}^2 x\)। चूँकि \(\int \sec^2 x\,dx = \tan x\) तथा \(\int \operatorname{cosec}^2 x\,dx = -\cot x\), अतः समाकल \(\tan x + \cot x + C\) है, जो विकल्प \(\tan x + \cot x + C\) है।

Q1e.en: The order of a differential equation is the order of the highest derivative in it; the powers do not matter. The highest derivative here is \(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\), so the order is 3, which is the choice 3.
Q1e.hi: अवकल समीकरण की कोटि उसमें उपस्थित उच्चतम अवकलज की कोटि होती है; घातों का इस पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता। यहाँ उच्चतम अवकलज \(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\) है, अतः कोटि 3 है, जो विकल्प 3 है।

Q2b.en: Differentiate both with respect to \(t\): \(\frac{dx}{dt} = 2at\) and \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 2a\). So \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt} = \frac{2a}{2at} = \frac{1}{t}\).
Q2b.hi: दोनों का \(t\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन कीजिए: \(\frac{dx}{dt} = 2at\) तथा \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 2a\)। अतः \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt} = \frac{2a}{2at} = \frac{1}{t}\)।

Q2c.en: Separate the variables: \(\frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = (1 + x^2)\,dx\). Integrating both sides, \(\tan^{-1} y = x + \frac{x^3}{3} + C\), which is the general solution.
Q2c.hi: चरों को पृथक् कीजिए: \(\frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = (1 + x^2)\,dx\)। दोनों पक्षों का समाकलन करने पर \(\tan^{-1} y = x + \frac{x^3}{3} + C\), जो अभीष्ट व्यापक हल है।

Q2d.en:
Integrate by parts, taking \(\log x\) as the first function and \(x\) as the second:
\(\int x \log x\,dx = \log x \cdot \frac{x^2}{2} - \int \frac{1}{x} \cdot \frac{x^2}{2}\,dx = \frac{x^2}{2}\log x - \frac{x^2}{4} + C\).
Q2d.hi:
खण्डशः समाकलन से, \(\log x\) को प्रथम फलन तथा \(x\) को द्वितीय फलन लेकर:
\(\int x \log x\,dx = \log x \cdot \frac{x^2}{2} - \int \frac{1}{x} \cdot \frac{x^2}{2}\,dx = \frac{x^2}{2}\log x - \frac{x^2}{4} + C\)।

Q2e.en: By the multiplication theorem, \(P(A \cap B) = P(A)\,P(B|A) = 0.8 \times 0.4 = 0.32\). Then \(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = 0.8 + 0.5 - 0.32 = 0.98\).

Q3a.en:
The function \(f(x) = \tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\) is defined for all real \(x\) with \(\cos x \ne 0\), that is, \(x \ne (2n + 1)\frac{\pi}{2}\), \(n \in Z\).
Let \(c\) be any point of this domain, so \(\cos c \ne 0\). Since \(\sin x\) and \(\cos x\) are continuous everywhere,
\(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c} \frac{\sin x}{\cos x} = \frac{\lim_{x \to c} \sin x}{\lim_{x \to c} \cos x} = \frac{\sin c}{\cos c} = \tan c = f(c)\).
So \(f\) is continuous at every point of its domain. Hence \(f(x) = \tan x\) is a continuous function.
Q3a.hi:
फलन \(f(x) = \tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\) उन सभी वास्तविक \(x\) के लिए परिभाषित है जिनके लिए \(\cos x \ne 0\), अर्थात् \(x \ne (2n + 1)\frac{\pi}{2}\), \(n \in Z\)।
मान लीजिए \(c\) इस प्रान्त का कोई बिन्दु है, अतः \(\cos c \ne 0\)। चूँकि \(\sin x\) तथा \(\cos x\) सर्वत्र सतत् हैं,
\(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c} \frac{\sin x}{\cos x} = \frac{\lim_{x \to c} \sin x}{\lim_{x \to c} \cos x} = \frac{\sin c}{\cos c} = \tan c = f(c)\)।
अतः \(f\) अपने प्रान्त के प्रत्येक बिन्दु पर सतत् है। इसलिए \(f(x) = \tan x\) एक सतत् फलन है।

Q3b.en:
We check the three properties.
**Reflexive:** for any \((a, b) \in N \times N\), \(ab = ba\), so \((a, b) R (a, b)\).
**Symmetric:** if \((a, b) R (c, d)\), then \(ad = bc\), so \(cb = da\), which means \((c, d) R (a, b)\).
**Transitive:** if \((a, b) R (c, d)\) and \((c, d) R (e, f)\), then \(ad = bc\) and \(cf = de\). Multiplying, \(ad \cdot cf = bc \cdot de\). Since \(c, d \in N\) are non-zero, dividing by \(cd\) gives \(af = be\), so \((a, b) R (e, f)\).
The relation \(R\) is reflexive, symmetric and transitive, so \(R\) is an equivalence relation.
Q3b.hi:
हम तीनों गुणों की जाँच करते हैं।
**स्वतुल्य:** किसी भी \((a, b) \in N \times N\) के लिए \(ab = ba\), अतः \((a, b) R (a, b)\)।
**सममित:** यदि \((a, b) R (c, d)\), तो \(ad = bc\), अतः \(cb = da\), अर्थात् \((c, d) R (a, b)\)।
**संक्रामक:** यदि \((a, b) R (c, d)\) तथा \((c, d) R (e, f)\), तो \(ad = bc\) तथा \(cf = de\)। गुणा करने पर \(ad \cdot cf = bc \cdot de\)। चूँकि \(c, d \in N\) शून्येतर हैं, \(cd\) से भाग देने पर \(af = be\), अतः \((a, b) R (e, f)\)।
सम्बन्ध \(R\) स्वतुल्य, सममित तथा संक्रामक है, अतः \(R\) एक तुल्यता सम्बन्ध है।

Q3c.en:
Complete the square: \(2x - x^2 = -(x^2 - 2x + 1) + 1 = 1 - (x - 1)^2\).
So \(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{2x - x^2}}\,dx = \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - (x - 1)^2}}\,dx\). Putting \(x - 1 = t\), \(dx = dt\):
\(\int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{1 - t^2}} = \sin^{-1} t + C = \sin^{-1}(x - 1) + C\).

Q3d.en:
Find the side vectors:
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = \vec{b} - \vec{a} = -\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}\),
\(\overrightarrow{BC} = \vec{c} - \vec{b} = -\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 6\hat{k}\),
\(\overrightarrow{CA} = \vec{a} - \vec{c} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\).
Their sum is zero and no two are parallel, so the three points form a triangle. Now
\(\overrightarrow{CA} \cdot \overrightarrow{AB} = (2)(-1) + (-1)(3) + (1)(5) = -2 - 3 + 5 = 0\),
so the sides \(CA\) and \(AB\) are perpendicular and the angle at the point A is \(90^\circ\). (Check: \(|\overrightarrow{AB}|^2 = 35\), \(|\overrightarrow{CA}|^2 = 6\), \(|\overrightarrow{BC}|^2 = 41 = 35 + 6\).)
Hence the points form the vertices of a right-angled triangle.
Q3d.hi:
भुजा सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए:
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = \vec{b} - \vec{a} = -\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}\),
\(\overrightarrow{BC} = \vec{c} - \vec{b} = -\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 6\hat{k}\),
\(\overrightarrow{CA} = \vec{a} - \vec{c} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\)।
इनका योग शून्य है और कोई दो समान्तर नहीं हैं, अतः तीनों बिन्दु एक त्रिभुज बनाते हैं। अब
\(\overrightarrow{CA} \cdot \overrightarrow{AB} = (2)(-1) + (-1)(3) + (1)(5) = -2 - 3 + 5 = 0\),
अतः भुजाएँ \(CA\) तथा \(AB\) परस्पर लम्बवत् हैं और बिन्दु A पर कोण \(90^\circ\) है। (जाँच: \(|\overrightarrow{AB}|^2 = 35\), \(|\overrightarrow{CA}|^2 = 6\), \(|\overrightarrow{BC}|^2 = 41 = 35 + 6\)।)
अतः ये बिन्दु एक समकोण त्रिभुज के शीर्ष हैं।

Q4a.en:
\(2\begin{bmatrix} x & 5 \\ 7 & y - 3 \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -4 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2x + 3 & 6 \\ 15 & 2y - 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 7 & 6 \\ 15 & 10 \end{bmatrix}\).
Equating corresponding elements: \(2x + 3 = 7\), so \(x = 2\); and \(2y - 4 = 10\), so \(y = 7\).
Q4a.hi:
\(2\begin{bmatrix} x & 5 \\ 7 & y - 3 \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -4 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2x + 3 & 6 \\ 15 & 2y - 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 7 & 6 \\ 15 & 10 \end{bmatrix}\)।
संगत अवयवों की तुलना करने पर: \(2x + 3 = 7\), अतः \(x = 2\); तथा \(2y - 4 = 10\), अतः \(y = 7\)।

Q4b.en:
Here \(\frac{dx}{dt} = -3\) cm/min (decreasing) and \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 2\) cm/min. The area is \(A = xy\), so
\(\frac{dA}{dt} = x\frac{dy}{dt} + y\frac{dx}{dt} = 5(2) + 3(-3) = 10 - 9 = 1\).
So the area of the rectangle is increasing at the rate of 1 cm²/min.
Q4b.hi:
यहाँ \(\frac{dx}{dt} = -3\) सेमी/मिनट (घट रही है) तथा \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 2\) सेमी/मिनट। क्षेत्रफल \(A = xy\), अतः
\(\frac{dA}{dt} = x\frac{dy}{dt} + y\frac{dx}{dt} = 5(2) + 3(-3) = 10 - 9 = 1\)।
अतः आयत का क्षेत्रफल 1 सेमी²/मिनट की दर से बढ़ रहा है।

Q4c.en:
Given \(y = a\cos x + b\sin x\). Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -a\sin x + b\cos x\),
\(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = -a\cos x - b\sin x = -(a\cos x + b\sin x) = -y\).
So \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + y = -y + y = 0\). Hence the function is a solution of the given differential equation.
Q4c.hi:
दिया है \(y = a\cos x + b\sin x\)। \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -a\sin x + b\cos x\),
\(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = -a\cos x - b\sin x = -(a\cos x + b\sin x) = -y\)।
अतः \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + y = -y + y = 0\)। इसलिए दिया गया फलन अवकल समीकरण का हल है।

Q4d.en:
Since \(E\) and \(F\) are independent, \(P(E \cap F) = P(E)\,P(F)\).
The events \(E \cap F\) and \(E \cap F'\) are mutually exclusive and their union is \(E\), so \(P(E) = P(E \cap F) + P(E \cap F')\). Therefore
\(P(E \cap F') = P(E) - P(E \cap F) = P(E) - P(E)\,P(F) = P(E)\,[1 - P(F)] = P(E)\,P(F')\).
Hence \(E\) and \(F'\) are independent.
Q4d.hi:
चूँकि \(E\) और \(F\) स्वतन्त्र हैं, \(P(E \cap F) = P(E)\,P(F)\)।
घटनाएँ \(E \cap F\) तथा \(E \cap F'\) परस्पर अपवर्जी हैं और इनका सम्मिलन \(E\) है, अतः \(P(E) = P(E \cap F) + P(E \cap F')\)। इसलिए
\(P(E \cap F') = P(E) - P(E \cap F) = P(E) - P(E)\,P(F) = P(E)\,[1 - P(F)] = P(E)\,P(F')\)।
अतः \(E\) और \(F'\) भी स्वतन्त्र घटनाएँ हैं।

Q5a.en:
Expand along the first row:
\(\Delta = 17\begin{vmatrix} -8 & 7 \\ 2 & 5 \end{vmatrix} - 15\begin{vmatrix} 9 & 7 \\ -3 & 5 \end{vmatrix} + 13\begin{vmatrix} 9 & -8 \\ -3 & 2 \end{vmatrix}\)
\(= 17(-40 - 14) - 15(45 + 21) + 13(18 - 24)\)
\(= 17(-54) - 15(66) + 13(-6)\)
\(= -918 - 990 - 78 = -1986\).
So the value of the determinant is \(-1986\).

Q5b.en:
Let \(\sin^{-1}\frac{12}{13} = \alpha\) and \(\cos^{-1}\frac{4}{5} = \beta\), where \(\alpha, \beta \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\).
Then \(\sin\alpha = \frac{12}{13}\), \(\cos\alpha = \frac{5}{13}\), so \(\tan\alpha = \frac{12}{5}\); and \(\cos\beta = \frac{4}{5}\), \(\sin\beta = \frac{3}{5}\), so \(\tan\beta = \frac{3}{4}\).
\(\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta} = \frac{\frac{12}{5} + \frac{3}{4}}{1 - \frac{12}{5} \cdot \frac{3}{4}} = \frac{\frac{63}{20}}{-\frac{16}{20}} = -\frac{63}{16}\).
Since \(0 < \alpha + \beta < \pi\) and its tangent is negative, \(\alpha + \beta\) lies in \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)\). So \(\tan(\pi - (\alpha + \beta)) = \frac{63}{16}\) with \(\pi - (\alpha + \beta) \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), giving \(\pi - (\alpha + \beta) = \tan^{-1}\frac{63}{16}\).
Therefore \(\alpha + \beta + \tan^{-1}\frac{63}{16} = \pi\), that is, \(\sin^{-1}\frac{12}{13} + \cos^{-1}\frac{4}{5} + \tan^{-1}\frac{63}{16} = \pi\). Hence proved.
Q5b.hi:
माना \(\sin^{-1}\frac{12}{13} = \alpha\) तथा \(\cos^{-1}\frac{4}{5} = \beta\), जहाँ \(\alpha, \beta \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)।
तब \(\sin\alpha = \frac{12}{13}\), \(\cos\alpha = \frac{5}{13}\), अतः \(\tan\alpha = \frac{12}{5}\); तथा \(\cos\beta = \frac{4}{5}\), \(\sin\beta = \frac{3}{5}\), अतः \(\tan\beta = \frac{3}{4}\)।
\(\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta} = \frac{\frac{12}{5} + \frac{3}{4}}{1 - \frac{12}{5} \cdot \frac{3}{4}} = \frac{\frac{63}{20}}{-\frac{16}{20}} = -\frac{63}{16}\)।
चूँकि \(0 < \alpha + \beta < \pi\) और इसकी स्पर्शज्या ऋणात्मक है, अतः \(\alpha + \beta\) अन्तराल \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)\) में है। इसलिए \(\tan(\pi - (\alpha + \beta)) = \frac{63}{16}\), जहाँ \(\pi - (\alpha + \beta) \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), अतः \(\pi - (\alpha + \beta) = \tan^{-1}\frac{63}{16}\)।
अतः \(\alpha + \beta + \tan^{-1}\frac{63}{16} = \pi\), अर्थात् \(\sin^{-1}\frac{12}{13} + \cos^{-1}\frac{4}{5} + \tan^{-1}\frac{63}{16} = \pi\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q5c.en:
Differentiate both with respect to \(t\):
\(\frac{dx}{dt} = 3a\sin^2 t\cos t\), \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 3b\cos^2 t \cdot (-\sin t) = -3b\cos^2 t\sin t\).
So \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt} = \frac{-3b\cos^2 t\sin t}{3a\sin^2 t\cos t} = -\frac{b}{a}\cdot\frac{\cos t}{\sin t} = -\frac{b}{a}\cot t\).
At \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\): \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{b}{a}\cot\frac{\pi}{2} = -\frac{b}{a} \times 0 = 0\).
Q5c.hi:
दोनों का \(t\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन कीजिए:
\(\frac{dx}{dt} = 3a\sin^2 t\cos t\), \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 3b\cos^2 t \cdot (-\sin t) = -3b\cos^2 t\sin t\)।
अतः \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt} = \frac{-3b\cos^2 t\sin t}{3a\sin^2 t\cos t} = -\frac{b}{a}\cdot\frac{\cos t}{\sin t} = -\frac{b}{a}\cot t\)।
\(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) पर: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{b}{a}\cot\frac{\pi}{2} = -\frac{b}{a} \times 0 = 0\)।

Q5d.en:
Each vector is perpendicular to the sum of the other two, so
\(\vec{a} \cdot (\vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\), \(\vec{b} \cdot (\vec{c} + \vec{a}) = 0\), \(\vec{c} \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = 0\).
Adding the three: \(2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\), so \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = 0\).
Now
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|^2 = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 9 + 16 + 25 + 0 = 50\).
Therefore \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}| = \sqrt{50} = 5\sqrt{2}\).
Q5d.hi:
प्रत्येक सदिश अन्य दो के योगफल पर लम्बवत् है, अतः
\(\vec{a} \cdot (\vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\), \(\vec{b} \cdot (\vec{c} + \vec{a}) = 0\), \(\vec{c} \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = 0\)।
तीनों को जोड़ने पर: \(2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\), अतः \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = 0\)।
अब
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|^2 = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 9 + 16 + 25 + 0 = 50\)।
अतः \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}| = \sqrt{50} = 5\sqrt{2}\)।

Q5e.en:
Rewrite the equation: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{xy + y^2}{2x^2}\). The right side is a homogeneous function of degree zero, so put \(y = vx\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\):
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = -\frac{v + v^2}{2}\), so \(x\frac{dv}{dx} = -\frac{v^2 + 3v}{2} = -\frac{v(v + 3)}{2}\).
Separating the variables: \(\frac{dv}{v(v + 3)} = -\frac{dx}{2x}\). Using partial fractions, \(\frac{1}{v(v + 3)} = \frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{1}{v} - \frac{1}{v + 3}\right)\), so integrating,
\(\frac{1}{3}\log\left|\frac{v}{v + 3}\right| = -\frac{1}{2}\log|x| + C\).
Multiplying by 6: \(2\log\left|\frac{v}{v + 3}\right| + 3\log|x| = 6C\), so \(\frac{v^2 x^3}{(v + 3)^2} = K\) (a constant).
Putting \(v = \frac{y}{x}\): \(\frac{v}{v + 3} = \frac{y}{y + 3x}\), so \(\frac{x^3 y^2}{(y + 3x)^2} = K\).
When \(x = 1\), \(y = 1\): \(\frac{1}{16} = K\).
Hence the particular solution is \((y + 3x)^2 = 16x^3y^2\).
Q5e.hi:
समीकरण को इस रूप में लिखिए: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{xy + y^2}{2x^2}\)। दायाँ पक्ष शून्य घात का समघातीय फलन है, अतः \(y = vx\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\) रखिए:
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = -\frac{v + v^2}{2}\), अतः \(x\frac{dv}{dx} = -\frac{v^2 + 3v}{2} = -\frac{v(v + 3)}{2}\)।
चरों को पृथक् करने पर: \(\frac{dv}{v(v + 3)} = -\frac{dx}{2x}\)। आंशिक भिन्नों से \(\frac{1}{v(v + 3)} = \frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{1}{v} - \frac{1}{v + 3}\right)\), अतः समाकलन करने पर
\(\frac{1}{3}\log\left|\frac{v}{v + 3}\right| = -\frac{1}{2}\log|x| + C\)।
6 से गुणा करने पर: \(2\log\left|\frac{v}{v + 3}\right| + 3\log|x| = 6C\), अतः \(\frac{v^2 x^3}{(v + 3)^2} = K\) (अचर)।
\(v = \frac{y}{x}\) रखने पर: \(\frac{v}{v + 3} = \frac{y}{y + 3x}\), अतः \(\frac{x^3 y^2}{(y + 3x)^2} = K\)।
जब \(x = 1\), \(y = 1\): \(\frac{1}{16} = K\)।
अतः अभीष्ट विशिष्ट हल \((y + 3x)^2 = 16x^3y^2\) है।

Q6a.en:
The given line \(\frac{x + 3}{3} = \frac{y - 4}{5} = \frac{z - 8}{6}\) has direction ratios 3, 5, 6. A line parallel to it has the same direction ratios.
The line through \((x_1, y_1, z_1)\) with direction ratios \(a, b, c\) is \(\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}\). With the point \((-1, 4, -5)\) and direction ratios 3, 5, 6, the required Cartesian equation is
\(\frac{x + 1}{3} = \frac{y - 4}{5} = \frac{z + 5}{6}\).
Q6a.hi:
दी गई रेखा \(\frac{x + 3}{3} = \frac{y - 4}{5} = \frac{z - 8}{6}\) के दिक्-अनुपात 3, 5, 6 हैं। इसके समान्तर रेखा के दिक्-अनुपात भी यही होंगे।
बिन्दु \((x_1, y_1, z_1)\) से जाने वाली तथा दिक्-अनुपात \(a, b, c\) वाली रेखा का समीकरण \(\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}\) होता है। बिन्दु \((-1, 4, -5)\) तथा दिक्-अनुपात 3, 5, 6 लेने पर अभीष्ट कार्तीय समीकरण है
\(\frac{x + 1}{3} = \frac{y - 4}{5} = \frac{z + 5}{6}\)।

Q6b.en:
Draw the lines \(2x + y = 80\) (through \((40, 0)\) and \((0, 80)\)) and \(x + y = 50\) (through \((50, 0)\) and \((0, 50)\)). Both inequalities are satisfied by the origin, so the feasible region lies on the origin side of both lines, in the first quadrant.
The two lines meet where \(2x + y = 80\) and \(x + y = 50\): subtracting, \(x = 30\), then \(y = 20\).
The feasible region is the bounded quadrilateral with corner points \(O(0, 0)\), \((40, 0)\), \((30, 20)\) and \((0, 50)\).

| Corner point | \(Z = 105x + 90y\) |
|---|---|
| \((0, 0)\) | 0 |
| \((40, 0)\) | 4200 |
| \((30, 20)\) | 3150 + 1800 = 4950 |
| \((0, 50)\) | 4500 |

Since the region is bounded, the maximum occurs at a corner point. The maximum value of \(Z\) is 4950, at \(x = 30\), \(y = 20\).

Q6c.en:
Throwing two dice gives 36 equally likely outcomes.
Let \(F\) be the event that the two numbers are different. The outcomes with equal numbers are \((1,1), (2,2), \ldots, (6,6)\), six in all, so \(n(F) = 36 - 6 = 30\) and \(P(F) = \frac{30}{36}\).
Let \(E\) be the event that the sum is 4: \(E = \{(1, 3), (2, 2), (3, 1)\}\). Then \(E \cap F = \{(1, 3), (3, 1)\}\), so \(P(E \cap F) = \frac{2}{36}\).
By conditional probability,
\(P(E|F) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(F)} = \frac{2/36}{30/36} = \frac{2}{30} = \frac{1}{15}\).
So the required probability is \(\frac{1}{15}\).

Q6d.en:
Write the equation as a linear equation in \(x\): \(y\,dx = (y^2 - x)\,dy\), so
\(\frac{dx}{dy} + \frac{1}{y}x = y\).
This is of the form \(\frac{dx}{dy} + P_1 x = Q_1\) with \(P_1 = \frac{1}{y}\), \(Q_1 = y\).
Integrating factor: \(\text{I.F.} = e^{\int \frac{1}{y}dy} = e^{\log y} = y\).
The solution is \(x \cdot \text{I.F.} = \int Q_1 \cdot \text{I.F.}\,dy + C\):
\(xy = \int y \cdot y\,dy + C = \frac{y^3}{3} + C\).
So the general solution is \(xy = \frac{y^3}{3} + C\).
Q6d.hi:
समीकरण को \(x\) में रैखिक समीकरण के रूप में लिखिए: \(y\,dx = (y^2 - x)\,dy\), अतः
\(\frac{dx}{dy} + \frac{1}{y}x = y\)।
यह \(\frac{dx}{dy} + P_1 x = Q_1\) के रूप का है, जहाँ \(P_1 = \frac{1}{y}\), \(Q_1 = y\)।
समाकलन गुणांक: \(\text{I.F.} = e^{\int \frac{1}{y}dy} = e^{\log y} = y\)।
हल \(x \cdot \text{I.F.} = \int Q_1 \cdot \text{I.F.}\,dy + C\) से:
\(xy = \int y \cdot y\,dy + C = \frac{y^3}{3} + C\)।
अतः व्यापक हल \(xy = \frac{y^3}{3} + C\) है।

Q6e.en:
The sides from the vertex A are \(\overrightarrow{AB} = \vec{b} - \vec{a}\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC} = \vec{c} - \vec{a}\). The area of a triangle is half the magnitude of the cross product of two of its sides:
Area of \(\Delta ABC = \frac{1}{2}|\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}|\).
Now
\((\vec{b} - \vec{a}) \times (\vec{c} - \vec{a}) = \vec{b} \times \vec{c} - \vec{b} \times \vec{a} - \vec{a} \times \vec{c} + \vec{a} \times \vec{a}\).
Using \(\vec{a} \times \vec{a} = \vec{0}\), \(-\vec{b} \times \vec{a} = \vec{a} \times \vec{b}\) and \(-\vec{a} \times \vec{c} = \vec{c} \times \vec{a}\):
\((\vec{b} - \vec{a}) \times (\vec{c} - \vec{a}) = \vec{a} \times \vec{b} + \vec{b} \times \vec{c} + \vec{c} \times \vec{a}\).
Therefore the area of \(\Delta ABC = \frac{1}{2}|\vec{a} \times \vec{b} + \vec{b} \times \vec{c} + \vec{c} \times \vec{a}|\). Hence proved.
Q6e.hi:
शीर्ष A से भुजाएँ \(\overrightarrow{AB} = \vec{b} - \vec{a}\) तथा \(\overrightarrow{AC} = \vec{c} - \vec{a}\) हैं। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल उसकी दो भुजाओं के सदिश गुणनफल के परिमाण का आधा होता है:
\(\Delta ABC\) का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{1}{2}|\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}|\)।
अब
\((\vec{b} - \vec{a}) \times (\vec{c} - \vec{a}) = \vec{b} \times \vec{c} - \vec{b} \times \vec{a} - \vec{a} \times \vec{c} + \vec{a} \times \vec{a}\)।
\(\vec{a} \times \vec{a} = \vec{0}\), \(-\vec{b} \times \vec{a} = \vec{a} \times \vec{b}\) तथा \(-\vec{a} \times \vec{c} = \vec{c} \times \vec{a}\) के प्रयोग से:
\((\vec{b} - \vec{a}) \times (\vec{c} - \vec{a}) = \vec{a} \times \vec{b} + \vec{b} \times \vec{c} + \vec{c} \times \vec{a}\)।
अतः \(\Delta ABC\) का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{1}{2}|\vec{a} \times \vec{b} + \vec{b} \times \vec{c} + \vec{c} \times \vec{a}|\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q7b.en:
**First part.**
\(A^2 = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 4 - 3 & -2 - 4 \\ 6 + 12 & -3 + 16 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -6 \\ 18 & 13 \end{bmatrix}\).
\(6A = \begin{bmatrix} 12 & -6 \\ 18 & 24 \end{bmatrix}\), \(11I = \begin{bmatrix} 11 & 0 \\ 0 & 11 \end{bmatrix}\).
\(A^2 - 6A + 11I = \begin{bmatrix} 1 - 12 + 11 & -6 + 6 + 0 \\ 18 - 18 + 0 & 13 - 24 + 11 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = O\).
So the matrix satisfies \(A^2 - 6A + 11I = O\).
**Finding the inverse.** \(|A| = 8 + 3 = 11 \ne 0\), so \(A^{-1}\) exists. Multiply \(A^2 - 6A + 11I = O\) by \(A^{-1}\):
\(A^2A^{-1} - 6AA^{-1} + 11IA^{-1} = OA^{-1}\), that is, \(A - 6I + 11A^{-1} = O\).
So \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{11}(6I - A) = \frac{1}{11}\left(\begin{bmatrix} 6 & 0 \\ 0 & 6 \end{bmatrix} - \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\right) = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 4 & 1 \\ -3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\).
Q7b.hi:
**प्रथम भाग।**
\(A^2 = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 4 - 3 & -2 - 4 \\ 6 + 12 & -3 + 16 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -6 \\ 18 & 13 \end{bmatrix}\)।
\(6A = \begin{bmatrix} 12 & -6 \\ 18 & 24 \end{bmatrix}\), \(11I = \begin{bmatrix} 11 & 0 \\ 0 & 11 \end{bmatrix}\)।
\(A^2 - 6A + 11I = \begin{bmatrix} 1 - 12 + 11 & -6 + 6 + 0 \\ 18 - 18 + 0 & 13 - 24 + 11 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = O\)।
अतः आव्यूह समीकरण \(A^2 - 6A + 11I = O\) को सन्तुष्ट करता है।
**व्युत्क्रम ज्ञात करना।** \(|A| = 8 + 3 = 11 \ne 0\), अतः \(A^{-1}\) का अस्तित्व है। \(A^2 - 6A + 11I = O\) को \(A^{-1}\) से गुणा करने पर:
\(A^2A^{-1} - 6AA^{-1} + 11IA^{-1} = OA^{-1}\), अर्थात् \(A - 6I + 11A^{-1} = O\)।
अतः \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{11}(6I - A) = \frac{1}{11}\left(\begin{bmatrix} 6 & 0 \\ 0 & 6 \end{bmatrix} - \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\right) = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 4 & 1 \\ -3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\)।

Q8a.en:
The cone has height \(h\) and semi-vertical angle \(\alpha\), so its base radius is \(h\tan\alpha\). Let a cylinder of radius \(r\) and height \(H\) be inscribed in it, its base on the base of the cone.
Above the cylinder is a smaller cone of height \(h - H\) with the same semi-vertical angle, and the top rim of the cylinder lies on it. So
\(r = (h - H)\tan\alpha\).
Volume of the cylinder:
\(V = \pi r^2 H = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(h - H)^2 H = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(h^2H - 2hH^2 + H^3)\).
Differentiating with respect to \(H\):
\(\frac{dV}{dH} = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(h^2 - 4hH + 3H^2) = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(h - H)(h - 3H)\).
For a maximum, \(\frac{dV}{dH} = 0\): \(H = h\) (then \(r = 0\), no cylinder) or \(H = \frac{h}{3}\).
Second derivative: \(\frac{d^2V}{dH^2} = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(-4h + 6H)\). At \(H = \frac{h}{3}\), this is \(\pi\tan^2\alpha\,(-4h + 2h) = -2\pi h\tan^2\alpha < 0\).
So the volume is maximum when \(H = \frac{h}{3}\), that is, the height of the cylinder is one-third of the height of the cone.
Maximum volume:
\(V = \pi\tan^2\alpha\left(h - \frac{h}{3}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{h}{3} = \pi\tan^2\alpha \cdot \frac{4h^2}{9} \cdot \frac{h}{3} = \frac{4}{27}\pi h^3\tan^2\alpha\).
Hence proved.
Q8a.hi:
शंकु की ऊँचाई \(h\) तथा अर्द्धशीर्ष कोण \(\alpha\) है, अतः इसके आधार की त्रिज्या \(h\tan\alpha\) है। माना इसके अन्तर्गत त्रिज्या \(r\) तथा ऊँचाई \(H\) का एक बेलन है, जिसका आधार शंकु के आधार पर है।
बेलन के ऊपर ऊँचाई \(h - H\) का एक छोटा शंकु है जिसका अर्द्धशीर्ष कोण वही है, और बेलन का ऊपरी किनारा इस पर स्थित है। अतः
\(r = (h - H)\tan\alpha\)।
बेलन का आयतन:
\(V = \pi r^2 H = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(h - H)^2 H = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(h^2H - 2hH^2 + H^3)\)।
\(H\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dV}{dH} = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(h^2 - 4hH + 3H^2) = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(h - H)(h - 3H)\)।
उच्चिष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dV}{dH} = 0\): \(H = h\) (तब \(r = 0\), बेलन नहीं बनता) या \(H = \frac{h}{3}\)।
द्वितीय अवकलज: \(\frac{d^2V}{dH^2} = \pi\tan^2\alpha\,(-4h + 6H)\)। \(H = \frac{h}{3}\) पर इसका मान \(\pi\tan^2\alpha\,(-4h + 2h) = -2\pi h\tan^2\alpha < 0\) है।
अतः \(H = \frac{h}{3}\) पर आयतन अधिकतम है, अर्थात् बेलन की ऊँचाई शंकु की ऊँचाई की एक तिहाई है।
अधिकतम आयतन:
\(V = \pi\tan^2\alpha\left(h - \frac{h}{3}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{h}{3} = \pi\tan^2\alpha \cdot \frac{4h^2}{9} \cdot \frac{h}{3} = \frac{4}{27}\pi h^3\tan^2\alpha\)।
इति सिद्धम्।

Q8b.en:
Let \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin x\,dx\) ...(1)
Using \(\int_0^a f(x)\,dx = \int_0^a f(a - x)\,dx\):
\(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right)dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\cos x\,dx\) ...(2)
Adding (1) and (2):
\(2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log(\sin x\cos x)\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin 2x\,dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\) ...(3)
In \(I_1 = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin 2x\,dx\), put \(2x = t\), \(dx = \frac{dt}{2}\); when \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) and when \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t = \pi\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi} \log\sin t\,dt\).
Since \(\log\sin(\pi - t) = \log\sin t\), using \(\int_0^{2a} f(t)\,dt = 2\int_0^{a} f(t)\,dt\) when \(f(2a - t) = f(t)\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin t\,dt = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin x\,dx = I\).
Putting this in (3): \(2I = I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\), so \(I = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\).
Hence \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin x\,dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\).
Q8b.hi:
माना \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin x\,dx\) ...(1)
गुणधर्म \(\int_0^a f(x)\,dx = \int_0^a f(a - x)\,dx\) से:
\(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right)dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\cos x\,dx\) ...(2)
(1) तथा (2) को जोड़ने पर:
\(2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log(\sin x\cos x)\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin 2x\,dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\) ...(3)
\(I_1 = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin 2x\,dx\) में \(2x = t\), \(dx = \frac{dt}{2}\) रखिए; जब \(x = 0\) तो \(t = 0\) तथा जब \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) तो \(t = \pi\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi} \log\sin t\,dt\)।
चूँकि \(\log\sin(\pi - t) = \log\sin t\), गुणधर्म \(\int_0^{2a} f(t)\,dt = 2\int_0^{a} f(t)\,dt\) (जब \(f(2a - t) = f(t)\)) से:
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin t\,dt = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin x\,dx = I\)।
इसे (3) में रखने पर: \(2I = I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\), अतः \(I = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\)।
अतः \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log\sin x\,dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\)।

Q9a.en:
The circle \((x - 2)^2 + y^2 = 4\) has centre \((2, 0)\) and radius 2, so it runs from \(x = 0\) to \(x = 4\). It is symmetric about the x-axis, so its area is twice the area above the x-axis.
For the upper half, \(y = \sqrt{4 - (x - 2)^2}\). So
Area \(= 2\int_0^4 \sqrt{4 - (x - 2)^2}\,dx\).
Using \(\int \sqrt{a^2 - u^2}\,du = \frac{u}{2}\sqrt{a^2 - u^2} + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{u}{a}\) with \(u = x - 2\), \(a = 2\):
Area \(= 2\left[\frac{x - 2}{2}\sqrt{4 - (x - 2)^2} + 2\sin^{-1}\frac{x - 2}{2}\right]_0^4\)
\(= 2\left[(0 + 2\sin^{-1} 1) - (0 + 2\sin^{-1}(-1))\right]\)
\(= 2\left[2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2}\right] = 2 \cdot 2\pi = 4\pi\).
So the area of the circle is \(4\pi\) square units.
Q9a.hi:
वृत्त \((x - 2)^2 + y^2 = 4\) का केन्द्र \((2, 0)\) तथा त्रिज्या 2 है, अतः यह \(x = 0\) से \(x = 4\) तक फैला है। यह x-अक्ष के प्रति सममित है, अतः इसका क्षेत्रफल x-अक्ष के ऊपर वाले भाग के क्षेत्रफल का दोगुना है।
ऊपरी अर्द्धभाग के लिए \(y = \sqrt{4 - (x - 2)^2}\)। अतः
क्षेत्रफल \(= 2\int_0^4 \sqrt{4 - (x - 2)^2}\,dx\)।
सूत्र \(\int \sqrt{a^2 - u^2}\,du = \frac{u}{2}\sqrt{a^2 - u^2} + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{u}{a}\) से, जहाँ \(u = x - 2\), \(a = 2\):
क्षेत्रफल \(= 2\left[\frac{x - 2}{2}\sqrt{4 - (x - 2)^2} + 2\sin^{-1}\frac{x - 2}{2}\right]_0^4\)
\(= 2\left[(0 + 2\sin^{-1} 1) - (0 + 2\sin^{-1}(-1))\right]\)
\(= 2\left[2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} + 2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2}\right] = 2 \cdot 2\pi = 4\pi\)।
अतः वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल \(4\pi\) वर्ग इकाई है।

Q9b.en:
Let \(I = \int \left(\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x}\right)dx = \int \left(\sqrt{\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}} + \sqrt{\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}}\right)dx = \int \frac{\sin x + \cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x\cos x}}\,dx\).
Put \(\sin x - \cos x = t\). Then \((\cos x + \sin x)\,dx = dt\).
Squaring, \(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x - 2\sin x\cos x = t^2\), so \(1 - 2\sin x\cos x = t^2\), that is, \(\sin x\cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{2}\).
So
\(I = \int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{\frac{1 - t^2}{2}}} = \sqrt{2}\int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{1 - t^2}} = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1} t + C\).
Hence \(\int \left(\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x}\right)dx = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1}(\sin x - \cos x) + C\).
Q9b.hi:
माना \(I = \int \left(\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x}\right)dx = \int \left(\sqrt{\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}} + \sqrt{\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}}\right)dx = \int \frac{\sin x + \cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x\cos x}}\,dx\)।
\(\sin x - \cos x = t\) रखिए। तब \((\cos x + \sin x)\,dx = dt\)।
वर्ग करने पर \(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x - 2\sin x\cos x = t^2\), अतः \(1 - 2\sin x\cos x = t^2\), अर्थात् \(\sin x\cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{2}\)।
अतः
\(I = \int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{\frac{1 - t^2}{2}}} = \sqrt{2}\int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{1 - t^2}} = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1} t + C\)।
अतः \(\int \left(\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x}\right)dx = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1}(\sin x - \cos x) + C\)।

doubts.Q5c: At t = pi/2 both dx/dt and dy/dt are 0 (a cusp of the astroid), so the value 0 comes from the simplified form -(b/a)cot t, the standard board answer.
